checkpoints.description: Task 'palette-dodge-burn' completed successfully.

[1/3] Enforce base layer clipping invariants across document lifecycle. [2/3] Fix live Move tool translation for clipped layers and clipping bases in drawLayerStack. [3/3] Add comprehensive test coverage, run Phase 4 gates, and close UI contract.

impact_assessment.why: Clipped layers at index 0 become invisible and un-unclippable; live dragging of clipped layers shifts the mask instead of the content; tone/clone lacked unit tests.
impact_assessment.benefits: Base layer is guaranteed visible and unclipped across move/delete/load; live move drag accurately reflects committed results; full test verification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: layer 0 clipToBelow is always false; dependency: Canvas 2D only; concurrency: none; state: moving preview must not mutate layers directly.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reset clipToBelow on index 0 in document mutations and loaders, test moving/removing/loading layer 0, test canvas layer stack live translation.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: enforce base layer clipping invariants (clearing clipToBelow on layer 0 in document mutations, project loading, and autosave) and fix live move tool drag in drawLayerStack so clipped layers slide inside stationary base masks while base layer moves shift the mask; add unit tests across document, project, and autosave suites. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-clipping-fix' completed successfully.

[1/2] Route external clipboard image paste to addImageLayer when a document exists, and update clone tool overlay to follow active sampling offset during dragging. [2/2] Add test coverage for editor shortcuts and paste routing, verify UI contract, and pass Phase 4 gates.

impact_assessment.why: Pasting an image when a document is open discarded the document instead of adding a layer; clone crosshair was stationary during painting.
impact_assessment.benefits: Standard image editor pasting behavior; live feedback on exact clone sampling source; clean verification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no API changes; dependency: web standards clipboard only; concurrency: none; state: uncommitted files must pass checks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve openImageFile fallback when no document exists; verify with tests.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/2]-[2/2]: route external image paste to addImageLayer when document exists, live-track clone sampling offset in overlay during drag, and add unit test coverage. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-clone-paste-enhancements' completed successfully.

[1/2] Make export/save download verification resilient in dogfood.mjs via polling waitForFile, and commit active text draft before clipboard/layer-cut actions. [2/2] Support internal clipboard fallback in onPaste and add unit test coverage for text finishing on clipboard operations.

impact_assessment.why: Fixed 900ms wait in dogfood causes intermittent export download failures on Windows; clipboard operations were not finishing active text draft.
impact_assessment.benefits: Dogfood passes reliably under system load; text drafts are never lost when copying or cutting selections; seamless external and internal pasting.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no API changes; dependency: standard DOM and node:fs; concurrency: polling timeout avoids race conditions; state: ledger and clean tree.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use 4s bounded polling for downloads; test with unit tests and live dogfood run.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/2]-[2/2]: make dogfood export/save downloads resilient via polling waitForFile, finish active text draft on clipboard/layer-cut/pixel-clear operations, support internal clipboard fallback in onPaste, and add unit test coverage. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-dogfood-clipboard-polish' completed successfully.

[1/3] Wave 0 (commits 0-9 foundation): malformed stored values coerce to extremes - clampAdjustments('abc')->-100 (black layer), parseProject opacity 'abc'->0 (invisible); fix to neutral defaults with failing-first tests. [2/3] Wave 10 (commits 10-16 editor): onPaste hijacks text pastes into inputs when clipboard set; add typing-target guard. [3/3] Wave 17 (HEAD): full gates + README gate + verify clean, no push.

impact_assessment.why: Crafted .palette/autosave values render destructive extremes; text paste is hijacked after any copy
impact_assessment.benefits: Neutral fallback for bad stored values; text fields accept pastes again; gates stay green
impact_assessment.risks: contract: parse/clamp fallback values change for malformed input only; dependency: none (Node stdlib tests); concurrency: none (single project); state: ledger checkpoints per wave, commits without push
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first node tests; keep pinned ui.test.js paste-routing patterns intact; run npm test + aikit check per wave; explicit staging

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3] Wave 0: clampAdjustments falls back to per-key neutral defaults on non-finite input (was range minimum, e.g. 'abc'->-100 black layer); parseProject opacity falls back to 1 on non-finite (was 0 invisible), mirroring autosave.js. Failing-first tests in filters.test.js + project.test.js; 89/89 npm, 4/4 gates. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).

Extended paste-routing test; 89/89 npm, 4/4 gates. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).

[1/5] Plan: M1 core fill and filter modules; M2 UI shell and controls; M3 editor interaction and undo; M4 tests and dogfood; M5 UI contract and docs

impact_assessment.why: Palette lacked a paint bucket / flood fill tool, destructive invert filter, and zoom +/- shortcuts
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables rapid flat color fills, color replacement, quick tonal inversion, and standard keyboard zoom controls
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new tool and filter UI IDs; dependency: Canvas 2D only; concurrency: none; state: flood fill must respect layer lock, clipping mask, and selection bounds
impact_assessment.mitigation: Write pure core functions with 100% unit tests before wiring into UI; verify with headless dogfood pass

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/5]-[5/5]: added Paint bucket tool (K) with scanline/BFS flood fill, tolerance threshold, contiguous/non-contiguous replacement, and selection clipping in src/core/fill.js; added destructive Invert filter in src/core/filters.js and wired filter button; added keyboard zoom shortcuts (+/-); updated shortcut help dialog; bumped to 0.15.0 with 99 tests passing and verified via headless browser dogfood. Evidence: 99/99 npm tests pass, headless browser dogfood passes with bucket fill, invert filter, and keyboard zoom. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-fill-and-shortcuts' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: M1 core filter functions and unit tests; M2 UI controls and swatches; M3 editor wiring and UI tests; M4 dogfood verification; M5 docs, ADR and gate verification

impact_assessment.why: Add creative filters (desaturate, threshold, posterize) and quick color swatches to expand artistic retouching
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables high-contrast monochrome, posterized styling, and rapid color picking without opening OS color dialog
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, additive filters and swatches only; dependency: none, pure vanilla JS; concurrency: none, synchronous pixel manipulation and event loop; state: none, transforms return fresh pixel buffers and integrate with existing undo history
impact_assessment.mitigation: Clamp parameters, BT.709 luma, preserve alpha, verify in unit tests and CDP dogfood

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/5]-[5/5]: added Desaturate, Threshold (monochrome cutoff slider), and Posterize (color channel steps) filters in src/core/filters.js and src/ui/editor.js; added preset color swatches in index.html and src/styles.css; bumped to 0.16.0; verified via 103 unit tests and headless browser dogfood pass.
